# OneCrew Raises $7.5M in Series A Funding

-

August 20, 2025

OneCrew, a San Francisco, CA-based provider of a purpose-built platform for paving contractors, raised $7.5M in Series A funding.

The round was led by Stage 2 Capital, with participation from existing investors Entourage and Bienville Capital.

The company intends to use the funds to expand operations and its development efforts.

Led by CEO OneCrew provides a cloud-based platform that connects office, field, and subcontractor operations for paving contractors across the $150B paving industry, streamlining everything from accurate estimating and winning bids to managing crews and tracking costs.

Used by paving contractors throughout the US and Canada, from independent to national operators, OneCrew has helped customers achieve 40% revenue increases and 75% faster estimate creation.

# OneCrew raises $7.5M to digitise the $150B paving industry with unified contractor platform

by Sofia Chesnokova
...
August 20, 2025

 Image credits: OneCrew 

The paving industry has long relied on a bunch of spreadsheets, whiteboards, and handwritten notes to keep projects moving. This ad hoc system comes with costly inefficiencies, limited visibility, and lost revenue. OneCrew, a San Francisco startup, looks to disrupt this $150 billion market by delivering a unified platform tailor-made for paving contractors.
...
The company announced a $7.5 million Series A round led by Stage 2 Capital, with participation from existing investors Entourage and Bienville Capital, pushing its total funding to $11.75 million. The capital will fund product development and team growth as OneCrew pushes to digitise an industry still largely running on paper and disconnected systems.
...
The fresh funding will support launching a subcontractor portal and enterprise-level tools by year’s end, connecting more pieces of the paving supply chain than ever before.

# OneCrew Raises $7.5 Million in Series A

OneCrew, a San Francisco, CA-based software platform purpose-built for paving contractors, has raised $7.5 million in Series A funding.

 by Ben Murray 

 Updated August 21, 2025 

OneCrew, a San Francisco, CA-based software platform purpose-built for paving contractors, has raised $7.5 million in Series A funding. 

## Investors 

The round was led by Stage 2 Capital, with participation from existing investors Entourage and Bienville Capital. 

Stage 2 Capital is a venture capital firm that specializes in investing in early-stage B2B software companies. Backed by a large network of top tech executives, the firm helps founders move from product-market fit to scalable, predictable revenue through capital, strategic guidance, and its Catalyst Accelerator program. 

## OneCrew Use of Funds 

The company will use the funding to expand hiring, accelerate product development, and launch OneCrew’s Subcontractor Portal and enterprise platform. 

## About OneCrew 

Led by CEO Ari Bleemer, OneCrew is a cloud-based, all-in-one business management platform designed specifically for asphalt and concrete paving contractors. The platform streamlines everything from accurate estimating and winning bids to managing crews and tracking costs. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, OneCrew serves both independent contractors scaling through stronger operations and enterprises standardizing operations across multiple locations.
